name: Wye Oak
label: Merge
lede: Two Baltimore kids named their band after a centuries-old oak that had just blown down, made a record the A.V. Club called the best of 2011, and then Jenn Wasner put down the guitar.

eras.title: Named for a fallen tree
eras.text: Jenn Wasner and Andy Stack were a Baltimore duo that sounded like more people: Wasner on guitar and voice, Stack on drums while playing keyboard bass lines at the same time. They changed their name once, self-released a record, and Merge came calling.

years.src: Wikipedia: Wye Oak (band) · Wikipedia: Jenn Wasner
years.h: Jenn Wasner and Andy Stack start Monarch in Baltimore
years.p: Singer and guitarist Jenn Wasner and drummer and keyboardist Andy Stack form a duo called Monarch in Baltimore.
years.xp: Wasner, born in Baltimore in 1986, sang with her mother from an early age, took classical piano at about five and learned guitar from her mother at twelve. Her Wikipedia biography says her parents struggled with mental illness, addiction and money through her childhood.

years.src: Wikipedia: Wye Oak (band) · Wikipedia: Wye Oak
years.h: Monarch becomes Wye Oak, after Maryland's fallen state tree
years.p: The duo renames itself after the Wye Oak, the giant white oak that was Maryland's state tree until a storm brought it down in 2002.

years.h: If Children, Wye Oak's self-released debut
years.p: Wye Oak put out their first album, If Children, on their own.

years.h: Merge signs Wye Oak and reissues If Children
years.p: Merge Records signs the Baltimore duo and re-releases If Children. Pitchfork reviews the reissue that April.

eras.title: Civilian and the long road
eras.text: Wye Oak's second record doubled as a college assignment; the third one made year-end lists and got licensed into zombie television. Baltimore's scene was booming, and Wye Oak's friends Future Islands put Wasner's voice on their own record.

years.h: The Knot, Andy Stack's senior project at UMBC
years.p: Wye Oak record The Knot at the University of Maryland, Baltimore County, where Andy Stack is a student. He hands it in as his senior project.

years.h: My Neighbor/My Creator EP
years.p: Wye Oak's My Neighbor/My Creator EP bridges The Knot and the album that would break them.

years.h: Civilian, the A.V. Club's best album of 2011
years.p: Co-produced with [[John Congleton|6da4067f-e6ce-49b6-925c-56e017075038]], Civilian comes out on Merge in the US and City Slang in Europe. The A.V. Club puts it at No. 1 for the year.
years.xp:
AllMusic heard a brighter, better-recorded band with crisper songs. Stereogum later ranked it No. 95 among the albums of the 2010s.

For the tenth anniversary, on October 22, 2021, Merge reissued it as Civilian + Cut All the Wires 2009–2011, with a second disc of twelve demos and outtakes.

years.h: Jenn Wasner duets on Future Islands' The Great Fire
years.p: Baltimore neighbors [[Future Islands|74963434-dcb6-4b14-98cc-99873b06db66]] release On the Water, with Jenn Wasner of Wye Oak duetting with Samuel T. Herring on The Great Fire.

years.h: Civilian plays on The Walking Dead
years.p: Wye Oak's song Civilian scores the Walking Dead episode 18 Miles Out and turns up in the film Safety Not Guaranteed. Longmire, One Tree Hill and Animal Kingdom use it too.

eras.title: Putting down the guitar
eras.text: After years on the road with Civilian, Jenn Wasner was done with the instrument everyone knew her for. She moved to bass and synths, started side projects, and Wye Oak came back sounding like a different band.

years.h: Dungeonesse: Jenn Wasner's synth-pop duo with Jon Ehrens
years.p: Jenn Wasner and Baltimore producer Jon Ehrens release a Dungeonesse album on Secretly Canadian.

years.h: Wye Oak announce a fourth album with no guitar
years.p: Spin reports that Wye Oak are reinventing themselves and that Jenn Wasner has abandoned the guitar for the next record.

years.h: Shriek: bass, synths and a new Wye Oak
years.p: Made at Brooklyn's Rare Book Room with producer Nicolas Vernhes, Shriek hands the melodies that once belonged to Jenn Wasner's guitar to synthesizers.

years.h: Wye Oak team up with the Baltimore Symphony Orchestra
years.p: Merge announces a Shriek remixes EP and a Wye Oak collaboration with the Baltimore Symphony Orchestra.

years.h: Tween: the songs between Civilian and Shriek
years.p: Wye Oak release Tween, songs written, scrapped and repurposed between 2011 and 2014. The physical edition follows on August 5.

years.h: Flock of Dimes: Jenn Wasner's first solo album
years.p: Jenn Wasner releases If You See Me, Say Yes as Flock of Dimes on Partisan Records.

eras.title: Two careers, one band
eras.text: Wye Oak became something the two members came back to rather than lived inside. Jenn Wasner moved to Durham, North Carolina, joined Bon Iver and made solo records on Sub Pop, while the band kept releasing music on Merge.

years.cap: On the 2018 tour Wye Oak added a bassist for the first time
years.src: Wikipedia: The Louder I Call, the Faster It Runs · Wikipedia: Wye Oak (band)
years.h: The Louder I Call, the Faster It Runs, and a third player
years.p: Wye Oak's sixth album is mixed by [[John Congleton|6da4067f-e6ce-49b6-925c-56e017075038]], with Jenn Wasner and Andy Stack trading nearly every instrument. For the tour, William Joseph Hackney joins on bass.
years.xp: NPR called it the sound of a band shedding uncertainties. Critics heard dream pop over hard beats, and some of Wasner's most orchestral writing.

years.cap: Jenn Wasner in Bon Iver's live band
years.h: Jenn Wasner joins Bon Iver on guitar
years.p: Jenn Wasner joins [[Bon Iver|437a0e49-c6ae-42f6-a6c1-84f25ed366bc]]'s live band as a guitarist. Covid delays the tour, but she stays, and plays on Bon Iver's 2025 album Sable, Fable.

years.h: Flock of Dimes' Head of Roses on Sub Pop
years.p: Jenn Wasner's second Flock of Dimes album, Head of Roses, comes out on Sub Pop.

years.h: Every Day Like the Last, a Wye Oak compilation
years.p: Merge releases Every Day Like the Last, a Wye Oak compilation that follows the 2020 No Horizon EP.

years.h: Flock of Dimes' The Life You Save
years.p: Jenn Wasner's third Flock of Dimes album, The Life You Save, comes out on Sub Pop.
